subject.title: Feature: slash command to set preview streaming mode for current chat/session

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a persistent shared `/stream` session override across capable channels, and is `SessionEntry` plus explicit channel capability gating the intended contract?
rationale: The request creates a user-facing command and persistent cross-channel policy; implementation review alone cannot decide its lifetime, canonical modes, or initial channel set.

options.title: Sponsor shared session override
options.body: Adopt the linked PR direction with one canonical stored mode, explicit capability gating, reset-to-config semantics, and Telegram, Discord, and Slack as the reviewed MVP.

options.title: Use channel-owned commands
options.body: Keep streaming controls plugin-owned so each channel defines its own supported modes, storage, and native-command UX.

options.title: Keep configuration-only control
options.body: Retain static channel configuration and reload behavior as the supported operator path without session overrides.

recommendation.title: Sponsor shared session override
recommendation.body: Adopt the linked PR direction with one canonical stored mode, explicit capability gating, reset-to-config semantics, and Telegram, Discord, and Slack as the reviewed MVP.

likelyOwner.reason: The direct issue mention and subscription are the best available routing signals for this product choice, although code ownership is shared.
